about.title: About
about.headline: Headquartered in Sudan since 1987, serving twelve MENA markets.
about.deck: Zagros Trading has served farms across the region — from ministry-scale projects to family operations — for thirty-nine years. Six Sudan branches, twelve markets, seven international suppliers, three product lines under one roof. Consultancy, distribution, and after-sales support.

services.consultancy_body: Soil reports, application planning, crop diagnostics. The agronomy desk is on every order more complex than a single tank-mix — before the order, not after a problem.
services.fertilizers_body: Water-soluble K+S German chemistry plus Agro Dragon (Netherlands) specialty lines. Foliar, fertigation, and soil application across NPK, phosphate, nitrogen, potassium, and magnesium sources.
services.pesticides_body: Insecticides, herbicides, fungicides — sourced from Egyptian, Swiss, British, Indian, and Chinese manufacturers and supplied under the Agro- and Or- house lines.
services.seeds_body: Vegetable hybrids from East West Seeds (Thailand) and forage cultivars from Barenbrug (Australia) — varieties chosen for the heat, salinity, and pH profiles Sudanese fields actually face.

editors_note.headline: What separates an input distributor from a soil partner
editors_note.para1_body: he difference shows up at the second cut, not the bag. Anyone can move a pallet — fewer can tell you which K source won't lock out the calcium you'll need at fruit set, or why the irrigated lucerne block needs a different rate sheet than the rainfed one next door.
editors_note.para2: Issue 03 is built around three trials our agronomy desk audited in the last quarter — salt-stress tomato, citrus magnesium, and a side-by-side lucerne yield read. Each one is here because a customer asked us the question first.
editors_note.pull_quote: Specs forward. Data first. The bag arrives last.
editors_note.para3: If the catalog reads more like a service manual than a brochure, that's on purpose. Yield is the metric. Everything else is footnotes.
